game.title: Merge Battler
game.tagline: Merge orbs, summon your army, hold the castle.

hud.queueFull: Queue full — the next one leaves in a moment

single.label: Archer
single.blurb: Hits one target at a time. The all-rounder: never the best, never bad.

aoe.label: Pyromancer
aoe.blurb: Also hits enemies around its target. Devastating against tight packs.

slow.label: Frost mage
slow.blurb: Hits one target and chills the whole area around it. It buys you time.

support.label: Bannerman
support.blurb: Never strikes: he raises the damage and rate of fire of nearby allies.

heal.label: Healing potion
heal.blurb: Heals every living unit. Save it for the moment the line bends.

meteor.label: Meteor
meteor.blurb: Strikes the most threatening pack of enemies. Rushes do not get through.

plating.label: Plating
plating.description: +22% HP for units yet to come.

fortify.label: Fortifications
fortify.description: +22 castle HP, and as much healed right away.

resonance.label: Resonance
resonance.description: +45% chance an orb is a power.

help.title: How to play
help.gestures:
Tap an orb → it goes to battle, as the unit at the head of the queue.
Drag onto an orb of the same kind and tier → they merge.
Otherwise the two orbs swap places: keep your table tidy.
help.powersRule:
Round = power. Tap to use it at once: no queue, no wait.
A power only merges with the same power — never with a summoning orb.
help.rhythm:
The queue at the top shows the next 3 unit types; “skip” discards one ({seconds}s).
Every pause announces the coming wave. Every {waves} waves, an upgrade of your choice.
